title: fix(plugin-timeline): refuse a gantt row that is not an object
body:
Fixes #7364
Clause-②: no

## What this does

`classifyGanttRows` (plugin-timeline `renderer.tsx`) now refuses every gantt ROW that is not an object, not only `null`. A row that is a number, a string, a boolean or an array (`items: [0]`, `['x']`, `[true]`, `[[]]`) used to draw an empty, unlabelled row with no word to the author. It is now refused through the EXISTING `timeline.gantt.unusableRange.malformedRow` key, naming the path and value, for example `items[0] is 0, which is not a row shape` and `items[0] is an array, which is not a row shape`. No new key, no locale pack edit, no change to `validate`. The renderer now agrees with `validate`, which already refused these shapes at authoring time.

"Not an object" is `typeof row !== 'object' || row === null || Array.isArray(row)`: the set JSON can spell and the zod mirror (`z.object`) refuses. No prototype test is made (a `Date`, class instance or `Proxy` row cannot be written in JSON; the live-Proxy row control keeps drawing).

## This deliberately supersedes one clause of the objectui#7164 A+ ruling

Ruling: objectui#7364 comment 5809218505, UI closure batch 2 item 1, letter A, maintainer 「同意」. The #7164 A+ ruling required the control rows `items: [0]` and `items: [[]]` to keep DRAWING, and they were pinned as controls. **We are overriding that clause of the A+ ruling on the maintainer's word above.** The control assertions were not quietly "made green": each is rewritten to expect the refusal, with the ruling id stated beside it, and none is deleted:

- `timeline-gantt-malformed-row-7164.test.tsx`: the two control rows are removed from the DRAWS table with a comment pointing at the new block; a new block `a row that is NOT AN OBJECT is refused — objectui#7364 supersedes the #7164 control` pins `[0]`, `[[]]`, `['x']`, `[true]` as REFUSED at `items[0]` (diagnostic text, row clause, not the date clause, zero bars, empty axis, `role="alert"`), a non-object row beside good rows (`items[1] is 0`, wins over a later bad date), and a control that well-formed object rows (1 and 2 rows), a row with no `items` key and a row whose `items` is `null` still DRAW. The file header records the supersession.
- `timeline-gantt-date-brand-7027.test.tsx` pin 6: the same two former controls move out of the DRAWN list and are asserted as refusals, with the reason.
- `packages/types/src/__tests__/timeline-items-row-shape-7164.test.ts`: header comment only. It said `[0]` and `[[]]` "still DRAW in the renderer", which this change makes false; corrected. No assertion changed.

## One exclusion site moved (stated, not hidden)

`Array.isArray(row)` now runs before U3 reads `row.items`, so a revoked Proxy handed as a ROW dies at `IsArray` rather than `get`. That is the same move objectui#7164 already made for `items` and a row's `items`: same exclusion (JSON cannot spell a proxy), the site moved one operation up inside the same function. The pin 5 row in `timeline-gantt-date-brand-7027.test.tsx` is updated with that reason, and the `classifyGanttRows` docblock says so.

Red: the four non-object rows, the beside-good-rows case, the revoked-Proxy-as-ROW site pin, and pin 6's control block. The well-formed row controls stayed green. Restored with `git checkout HEAD --`; `git diff HEAD` empty and the on-disk blob hash equals the HEAD blob hash.
